meta.name: oh-my-issues
meta.description: Cluster a GitHub issue backlog by root cause into a small set of plan-master issues, redirect children with a standardized comment, and bundle architectural-fix PRs that close clusters atomically. Use when an issue tracker has accumulated dozens of reports that share underlying defects, when asked to triage / consolidate / cluster / dedupe issues, when asked to build a plan series or roadmap from open issues, or when routing a new incoming bug into an existing plan.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将 GitHub issue 按根因聚类为计划，自动重定向子问题并打包修复 PR
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果 issue 列表里堆满了重复报告，想按根因统一治理
copy.tagline_en: Cluster GitHub issues by root cause into plans, redirect children, and bundle fix PRs
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your issue tracker is cluttered with duplicate reports and you want to consolidate by root cause

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会把 GitHub 上成堆的 issue 按根因归成少数几个「计划主 issue」,原来那些子 issue 用统一话术关闭并跳转过去,每个簇再用一个 PR 原子关闭全部子 issue。新报的 bug 不再单独开 issue,而是追加到匹配的主 issue 里。
howto.when: 当仓库积压 20+ 个疑似同源重复的 issue,或你要求 triage、cluster 等归并整理动作,或想把新报的 bug 并入已有计划时接管。

say.text: 把这个仓库的 open issue 按根因聚成几个计划
say.note: 会建立计划主 issue 并统一关闭子 issue

say.text: 这个新报的 bug 属于哪个已有计划?
say.note: 会匹配主 issue 并追加一条 Round N 评论

say.text: 给 plan-02 下这批子 issue 出一个 PR

howto.what_en: Claude groups a GitHub backlog by root cause into a few plan-master issues, closes children with a standard redirect comment, and ships one PR per cluster that closes them atomically. New bugs are appended to the matching master.
howto.when_en: Triggers when a repo has 20+ open issues that look like duplicates, when asked to triage, cluster or dedupe issues, or when routing a new bug into an existing plan.

say_en.text: Cluster this repo's open issues by root cause into plans.
say_en.note: Creates plan masters and redirects children.

say_en.text: Which existing plan does this new bug belong to?
say_en.note: Matches a master and adds a Round N comment.

say_en.text: Write a PR for plan-02's children that closes them all.
say_en.note: PR body lists Closes #N for each child.
